long_biography.plain_text:
Raised on a hill farm in Cumbria, Holroyd attended catering college and entered Trust House Forte, where he built and ran a national distribution network. At 29 he led a division with 1,500 staff, then left to establish Holroyd Meek in Oldham. The foodservice distributor grew nationally before its sale to Booker.

The exit opened a second career as an active investor and company director. His portfolio included chairmanships at Millie's Cookies and Positive Solutions and a long non-executive role at AO World. A visit to Bolton Lads and Girls Club gave that experience a philanthropic direction. He founded OnSide to replicate purpose-built youth facilities across the country, chaired it until 2020, and continues as a trustee.
